enemies.name: The Trickster
enemies.signature: Dazzle: 30 Light, apply pending Nausea and mark four Memory Holes (six below half HP). Anti-elemental: 30 counter damage, apply Holes and warn of H. H: 12 Chaos then 12 Light, shift the fullest row right two, above one, below three and mark three Hypnoses. False face: 30 Chaos, apply Hypnosis and warn of V. V: 12 Light then 12 Chaos, shift the fullest column down two, left one, right three and mark four Nauseas. Count all melded cards; ties topmost/leftmost. The full three-line pattern locks when warned; neighboring lines wrap at edges. Whole Constructs wrap one space at a time; crossing a Hole on any step destroys them immediately. Hypnosis compels at final landing. Corruptions can fill the grid. Each completed cycle adds 3 to single attacks and 2 to each split hit; Restless adds 1 per level to each hit. Anti-elemental counters the unique largest elemental Guard total including equipment; ties use Arcane. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Read all three committed lines and every space along each route. Holes destroy cards that pass over them, even when the final space is safe. Balance elemental Guard before Anti-elemental.
